prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +7.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Guidelines Redesign: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a split view with visual reference frames for custom photo submission. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, and adoption stage drops to 60.9% conversion.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Account Recovery Notification: Add an explicit reassurance badge and hint on the sign-in screen confirming existing pets are saved. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in, creating friction during authentication.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Waiting Tip Carousel: Add interactive pet care tips and explicit estimated waiting time during pet generation. (why: The waiting screen has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-offs before completion.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Final Desktop Overlay Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen at the end of onboarding to verify pet rendering on the active desktop screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop after setup, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
4: [adoption, copy] Pick Friend Personality Trait Copy: Update headline and body on pick_friend to emphasize unique companion personalities and desk play styles. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and decision fatigue during character selection adds to high completion time.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Interaction Launch Flow: Add a new launch screen after home_intro demonstrating basic desktop companion controls before completing setup. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Compact Sign-In Auth Card Layout: Reframe the sign-in options into a clean compact layout with onboarding progress visibility. (why: Sign-in screen mean time is high (567s) and 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen stalling or failing to display clearly.)
7: [adoption, hint] Certificate Naming Prompt Hint: Add a helpful hint on the adoption certificate screen to guide pet naming and personality confirmation. (why: Adoption stage has a 60.9% conversion rate and high median duration (89s), indicating hesitation during certificate sign-off.)
8: [home, hint] Waiting Background Rendering Hint: Add a prominent hint on the waiting screen explaining that pet rendering continues in the background if minimized. (why: Users wait a median of 201s / mean of 2336s on home stage, creating uncertainty if the window is moved or minimized.)

scores.note: Adoption stage drops heavily (60.9%) and support receives emails, but adoption redesigns consistently showed no/negative effect across 2 tests.
High support email volume (8 tickets) and sign-in notification changes previously delivered strong positive lift (+7.6%).
Extreme wait times on home step (201s median / 2336s mean) point to opportunity, though new flows on home previously saw -2.0%.
Finish step has low conversion (64.8%) and 3 emails, but adding a new screen at finish resulted in -6.0% lift in previous testing.
Target step drops many users (60.9%), copy changes are low-cost to deploy, but evidence is based on funnel metrics rather than direct support complaints.
Support emails confirm setup confusion, but introducing new screens into late onboarding stages historically decreases completion.
Sign-in step converts well (79.3%), and past sign-in layout/reorder tests showed flat/slightly negative results (-0.1%).
Adoption drops ~39% of users with high duration (89s); adding a simple guidance hint is config-only and low risk.
Extremely high wait duration on home stage indicates uncertainty; low-cost config hint can reduce abandonment during background rendering.
